status: Retrospective exploratory extension specified after the original findings were known, before running these extension analyses; not preregistration or independent confirmation.
reference: One owner-attested independent human reference; no new annotation or adjudication.

classification.macro_F1_classes: Classes with positive human-reference support; also report all class supports and undefined rates.
classification.dictionary_comparison: Same eligible paired IDs for human, GPT and dictionary; map mixed to neutral for both coders; omit human/GPT uncertain, record exclusions.

forecast.comparison: All lags share training and test eligibility; calendar shifts occur before filtering. This differs from the original 40-month experiment.
forecast.coefficient_path: Original expanding-window standardized ridge coefficients; range and sign stability are descriptive, not causal effects or formal structural-break tests.
forecast.multiple_testing_family: All paired comparisons already recorded under original analysis.json increments, including unfavorable results.
forecast.p_values: Two-sided null-centered segment-preserving circular-block bootstrap, add-one correction, Holm adjustment across the entire recorded family; exploratory approximate inference only.

same_event.selection: Purposive release-matched audit of existing headlines with at least two sources; dates, facts, metadata and URLs identify the releases. Earlier labels were visible: not a blind or exhaustive event sample.
same_event.benchmark: Same contemporaneous official release and observation period; retain different factual facets and genre as limitations, not evidence of distortion.
same_event.primary_members: Six straight-news headlines across three releases; one separately identified commentary is context only.

original_predictions_and_labels: Remain frozen; all additions are stored separately.
